methodological_eligibility.evidence_quote: This BuildCOM project will advance the state-of-the-art through the development and demonstration of an innovative interactive and user-friendly software for building management systems automated auditing and continuous building commissioning.

stage1.ineligibility_reason: Project report describing the BuildCOM software for building management system (BMS) automated auditing and continuous building commissioning. It presents software/tools (BuildCOM, ObepME) and qualitative points-based auditing frameworks (eu.bac / EN 15232, Smart Readiness Indicator) without presenting, proposing, evaluating or critiquing an EnPI/EnB measurement model in identifiable detail (no normalisation variables, functional form, or construction/estimation approach). Buildings sector.

paper_type.evidence_quote: The overall project delivery is an innovative software for building management systems automated auditing and continuous building commissioning.

stage1.notes: Buildings-sector project report; pervasive 'continuous commissioning' refers to continuous commissioning of buildings, NOT a continuous-process industry, so level_3b=false. Mild borderline on eligibility: the referenced ObepME tool compares measured data to a simulation-set baseline, but this paper does not characterise any EnPI/EnB model.
